description: 维也纳对局 C26 — 易位后王的安全防线具体分析

intro.popup_en: Castling, Lesson 2: What protects the king after castling? Examine the pawn shield and the pieces that cover the nearby squares.
intro.popup:
王车易位第2课
易位后王得到了全方位的保护！

outro.popup_en: After castling, the king is protected by a combination of pawns and pieces. The f-, g-, and h-pawns form the pawn shield, while a nearby minor piece can cover critical squares. King safety is a concrete structure, not just a move on the notation sheet.
outro.popup:
防线分析总结
易位后王前边有多种阻挡和保护！

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and occupies the center.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: Nc3 develops a knight and begins the Vienna Game.
moves.popup:
Nc3发展马
维也纳开局

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops and counterattacks e4.
moves.popup: Nf6发展并反击e4

moves.popup_en: f4! The Vienna Gambit is aggressive, but moving the f-pawn removes part of White's kingside shield. White should be especially attentive to king safety and castle promptly.
moves.popup:
f4！维也纳弃兵!
进攻性极强
但注意：f4走后王翼f兵消失
此时王更需要尽快易位保护！

moves.popup_en: ...d5! Black counterattacks in the center.
moves.popup:
d5！黑方反击中心
对称进攻

moves.popup_en: fxe5 captures and complicates the center.
moves.popup:
fxe5吃兵
中心复杂化

moves.popup_en: ...Nxe4! Black's knight jumps into the center and exploits the weakness on e4.
moves.popup:
Nxe4黑马跳入
利用e4弱点

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops and protects nearby squares, including h2 and g1. The knight is an important guard for the king after castling.
moves.popup:
Nf3发展
马在f3的重要性：
保护h2、g1格
是王易位后的贴身护卫！

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4 pins Nf3 and creates pressure. White can play Be2 to break the pin.
moves.popup:
Bg4牵制Nf3
黑方施加压力
正因如此白方要Be2解除牵制

moves.popup_en: d4 contests the center.
moves.popup: d4争夺中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops a knight.
moves.popup: Nc6发展

moves.popup_en: Be3 develops and prepares to place the bishop on e2.
moves.popup:
Be3发展
为Be2让位做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Be7! Black develops safely and clears f8, preparing to castle kingside.
moves.popup:
Be7！黑方稳健发展
象到e7，直接为易位铺路
g8+f8清空，随时可以O-O！

moves.popup_en: Be2! White both breaks the pin on Nf3 and completes the preparation for castling. The e-, f-, and g-files are clear, so White can castle.
moves.popup:
Be2！
一举两得：
1. 解除Bg4对Nf3的牵制
2. 为王易位做最后准备
现在e/f/g线清空，可以易位！

moves.popup_en: ...Bxf3 exchanges off White's knight, one of the king's nearby defenders.
moves.popup:
Bxf3黑方兑换
消灭护卫马

moves.popup_en: Bxf3 recaptures, leaving White with an active bishop on f3.
moves.popup:
Bxf3接回
白方f3有强力象

moves.popup_en: ...Nxc3 exchanges knights and changes the pawn structure.
moves.popup: Nxc3黑方兑换

moves.popup_en: bxc3 recaptures and gives White a semi-open c-file.
moves.popup:
bxc3接回
白方获得c线半开放

moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black castles immediately after the central exchanges. The king is safe behind f7, g7, and h7. Do not leave the king in the center once the position opens.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方立即易位！
中心兑换结束，王不能再等！
黑王安全到g8
兵盾：f7+g7+h7
这就是易位时机：子力交换后立刻易位！

moves.popup_en: O-O! White also castles. The king on g1 is shielded by f2, g2, and h2, while the bishop on f3 helps guard nearby squares. This is the concrete structure behind king safety.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方也易位！
现在仔细看王的防线：
王在g1
兵盾：f2+g2+h2
象在f3守护h1
这就是王安全的具体体现！

moves.popup_en: ...Re8! Black activates a rook on the e-file and targets White's e5-pawn. Castling both secures the king and activates a rook.
moves.popup:
Re8！黑车激活！
易位后车立刻占e线
e8对准白方e5兵
易位不只是王安全——车也激活了！

moves.popup_en: Re1! White mirrors Black and contests the e-file. Both kings are safe and both rooks are active: castling provides two benefits in one move.
moves.popup:
Re1！白车镜像激活！
双方e线对抗：Re1 vs Re8
王安全 + 车激活
这就是易位一步换两个收益的精髓！
